label: EARTH, AS PAINTED
colour: #3a5a7a
blurb: A blue disc in a sleeve printed with a sea. Ten pictures of a world nobody on the station has stood on.
price: 6

# INDEX.TXT
Ten paintings of Earth, scanned long ago and passed from disc to disc. Open them in Pictures; copy one to C: to make it your wallpaper.

WAVE.PIC  The Great Wave off Kanagawa. Katsushika Hokusai, about 1831.
STARRY.PIC  The Starry Night. Vincent van Gogh, 1889.
MONALISA.PIC  Mona Lisa. Leonardo da Vinci, about 1503.
SCREAM.PIC  The Scream. Edvard Munch, 1893.
PEARL.PIC  Girl with a Pearl Earring. Johannes Vermeer, about 1665.
WANDERER.PIC  Wanderer above the Sea of Fog. Caspar David Friedrich, about 1818.
HUNTERS.PIC  Hunters in the Snow. Pieter Bruegel the Elder, 1565.
SUNRISE.PIC  Impression, Sunrise. Claude Monet, 1872.
SUNFLWRS.PIC  Sunflowers. Vincent van Gogh, 1888.
HAYWAIN.PIC  The Hay Wain. John Constable, 1821.
